text:
marta: Quick idea — anyone up for a LAN-style swap & demo evening this Saturday? bring one Steam game you can demo and one physical item youd trade. hybrid folks welcome. :video_game:

alex: sounds great. 6-9pm works for me. I can bring extra controllers and some snacks.

jamie: Ill bring the Switch dock + a couple of retro pads. projector availability? @ops-bot

ops-bot: projector-reservation: Mezzanine projector booked for 2026-05-09 18:00-21:00 (confirmed).

ravi: maybe theme it "short bangers" or "weird co-op" so people can rotate quickly. small swap table for carts/cartridges too.

kevin: short bangers ftw. can someone make a shared list/spreadsheet so people dont DM duplicates?

marta: will do a quick sheet + poll for start time (6/7/8pm). linking in a sec.

alex: vote 6pm. earlier is better for evening plans.

jamie: 7pm for me so I have time to pick up snacks.

ravi: 6 or 7 work; 8 feels late for Sat.

kevin: 6pm from me.

marta: Poll: https://tinyurl.com/rw-lan-poll  Sheet: https://tinyurl.com/rw-lan-list — add what youre bringing and whether youre open to trade/demo.

alex: added: "Overcooked 2" (demo) + "Stardew Valley" (trade maybe).

jamie: added: "Tetris Effect" (demo) + will bring dock + "Mario Kart" accessories.

ravi: added: "Cuphead" demo + sealed retro handheld cart for trade. :eyes: 

kevin: for remote folks who want to share builds or ISOs: quick static serve snippet for local assets:

````
# quick static serve for local assets
python -m http.server 8080
# then share http://<your-local-ip>:8080 with folks on same network
````

marta: heads up — office wifi is on a private VLAN. if you want LAN-level sharing, bring a travel router/hotspot or use guest SSID. ops says NAT is strict.

ops-bot: network-note: guest SSID "redwood-guest" will be open for the event; limited bandwidth. for LAN traffic consider ad-hoc hotspot or wired.

jamie: Ill bring a little 5-port switch + some cables for wired setups.

alex: can we have sticky-note labels on swap table (offer/ask/price/trade-preference)? simple and fast.

marta: yes — Ill bring sticky notes, tape, and a small placard for rules. also bringing snacks (vegan options).

ravi: if turnout is small we can run a mini speedrun bracket for a few games.

kevin: if anyone has spare HDMI capture dongle, please bring it — well set up low-latency stream to remote folks.

marta: final: 6pm start this Sat in mezzanine. see you all! :partyparrot:

ops-bot: calendar-invite: "LAN Swap & Demo Night" added to #mezzanine calendar for 2026-05-09 18:00-21:00.

alex: hype. see you there!"
